summary: Howard Hughes Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the resignation of director Ben Hakim effective May 7, 2026, with no disagreement with the company or management. Pershing Square Holdco designated Marc Grandisson to fill the vacancy under the shareholder agreement. Separately, the company issued warrants to Grandisson to acquire 1,131,273 shares at $100 per share in a $10 million private placement, exercisable from April 2030 to April 2031. The warrant issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. What to watch: the board change signals Pershing Square's influence and aligns with activist-style board refreshment.
